name: Passport and ID Photo Cropper by Country

seo.title: Passport and ID Photo Cropper by Country — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Crop a local portrait against officially sourced passport-photo dimensions for supported jurisdictions, or use a clearly labeled custom preset.

assumptions: The tool applies geometry guides only; it does not certify pose, lighting, identity or application acceptance.
limitations: Government photo rules can change and some jurisdictions forbid or restrict digital alteration. Always re-check the linked official authority before submission.
